question: Kinesin and dynein are:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Kinesin and dynein -> Microtubular motors -> 95% CHAIN: Kinesin and dynein -> Involved in intracellular transport -> 90% CHAIN: Kinesin and dynein -> Move along microtubules -> 95%
enhanced_information: Kinesin and dynein are microtubular motors involved in intracellular transport. They move along microtubules, with evidence supporting their role in this process through interactions with kinetochores. Therefore, they are not adhesion proteins, degradative enzymes, components of the vesicular cover, or transcriptional factors.
